title: Store metadata, privacy policy and user docs

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
- F-Droid and Play both need a listing: title, short and full description, screenshots, a changelog per versionCode, and an icon.
- Play also needs a data-safety form and a privacy policy URL.
- PRIVACY.md exists, but it predates the reminder, export, and import changes.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Use the fastlane directory layout, which F-Droid reads directly and Play can consume via `fastlane supply` or manual upload. Keep the short description within 80 characters.
2. Take screenshots on an emulator in light and dark mode: dashboard, detail with chart and calendar, editor, and settings.
3. Update PRIVACY.md:
   - No network permission is requested.
   - Reminders are local.
   - Exports are unencrypted and user-managed.
   - Android auto-backup is disabled (`allowBackup=false`).
   - Delete-tracker semantics.
4. Draft the Play data-safety answers (no data collected or shared) in DEVELOPERS.md under "Release checklist".
5. Publish the privacy policy at the `docs/` GitHub Pages site (`docs/index.html`) so Play has a URL.
6. F-Droid inclusion is a request PR to fdroiddata by the owner. Document the steps; don't perform them.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `fastlane/metadata` validates against the F-Droid metadata layout docs.
- A review of PRIVACY.md against the manifest permissions matches.
